name: Kaleidoscope
author: Ambrotype
description: The photo through a kaleidoscope: mirrored slices round a centre, like the toy, or a fractal that folds the photo into itself again and again. It reads the whole photo at once.

params.name: style
params.label: Style
params.description: Mirrors: slices round a centre. Fractal: folded into itself, again and again.

params.name: slices
params.label: Slices
params.description: How many mirrored slices go round.

params.name: turn
params.label: Turn
params.description: Which part of the photo the slices show, in degrees.

params.name: depth
params.label: Depth
params.description: Fractal: how many times it folds.

params.name: twist
params.label: Twist
params.description: Fractal: how much each fold turns, in degrees.
